name: CM50_every_applicable_stage_runs
origins: user requirement 2026-11-04 (for any transformation from input to output, every functionality we want is used properly, so nothing is overlooked in the main function; tiers of modules and submodules, all run where needed)
docs/FOUNDATIONS.md D5 (a law is a conditional) and A1 (everything is a card)
statement: Every transformation from an input to its outputs runs every stage whose hypothesis the input satisfies, and its record has one entry per registered stage: ran with its evidence, or skipped, not requested, unavailable or failed with the reason. The set of stages that run is computed from the stage cards, never remembered by a command, and the coverage check fails when a stage function is named by no card, an engine is reached by no stage and named outside the pipeline by no reason, or a stage applies to nothing.
